integrity: The published facet-label characterization is reconstructed first. Intrinsic facet distance is the reciprocal norm of the centered labeling. Central symmetry reduces the global inball problem to maximizing that norm. A pairwise-variance argument gives a sharp range profile for every cyclic labeling walk, including equality cases. Tangent-normal ranks then prove odd-center uniqueness and the even incenter affine dimension. Exact facet enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unweighted cycle symmetric edge polytopes in the standard root-coordinate Euclidean realization. Weighted cycles have different Euclidean geometry. In even dimension the affine hull and dimension of the incenter set are determined, but no separate minimal inequality description of that center set is claimed.
title: Cycle symmetric edge polytopes have a parity-split exact Euclidean inradius
